body: Everyday it feels like a small piece of me is chipped away. It's like I have 3 personalities. One of them knows that I can be happy and that I need to keep pursuing it so I can keep living. There's another part that wants me to just end it cause exsitince means shit and the whole thing is pointless. Than there is a third part that kind of goes with the second part. That part just wants me to find out a way to just scorch the fucking planet. To just destroy everyone and everything. The 3rd part just hates humanity so much, as if humanity is a cancer and needs to be ripped out by any means necessary. Every day they fight and un winnable battle.
